prompt: Create SIX animation frames of EXACT same ninja in reference. Same thin athletic anatomy, black hood/face mask, only eyes visible, gray wrapped forearms/shins, black soft boots, same short sword right hand, rope belt and flowing black scarf. FAST LOW DASH-SLASH to RIGHT, distinct physical action driven by footwork and hips: 1 very low ready guard right hand reverse blade behind hip, left hand open front; 2 compress knees and load rear LEFT leg, shoulders slightly rotate preparing draw; 3 explosive push from rear foot, RIGHT foot reaches forward, hips translate RIGHT, right hand sweeps short blade forward at waist; 4 hit instant deep RIGHT forward lunge blade crosses forward diagonal-up, left arm back for counterbalance; 5 follow-through hips finish rotation with blade forward-high torso low, LEFT foot gathers; 6 recover low guarded stance right hand reverse blade behind hip left hand front. Do NOT repeat same stance with only sword angles changed. Show foot step, hip load, acceleration, followthrough and recovery. Short blade length unchanged, no katana. Right-side profile faces and ALL boot toe tips RIGHT heel LEFT, no front-facing/left-facing feet. Do not change anatomy/clothes. 6 equal square cells ONE horizontal row, whole ninja weapon scarf within each 16px margin; standing equivalent205 per256, floor230, compact poses never shrink body to fit weapon. Pure opaque RGB#FF00FF background, no text symbols grids shadows floor borders; no slash trail needed.
